CommunityApplications.Profile:
Plugins for getting more out of hardware that ships with Windows-only software.
**Corsair PSU Center** — an iCUE-style dashboard and fan control for Corsair HXi and RMi digital power supplies. Live per-rail voltage, current and power, temperatures, fan speed and efficiency, plus fan curve control and the +12V OCP rail toggle, all in its own tab.
Support and bug reports via GitHub issues on the project page.
